name: Export Media as ZIP
author: Huzoor Bux

sections.description:
Export Media as ZIP is a lightweight plugin that allows administrators to download all images from the WordPress media library as a ZIP file. It’s perfect for quick backups, migrations, or sharing image assets with clients.

Key Features

  • Export JPG, PNG, GIF, JPEG, and WEBP images
  • Admin-only access to the export feature
  • One-click download
  • No configuration needed
  • Compatible with all major themes and plugins

Support

If you have any questions or need help, please feel free to open an issue on GitHub or contact me at huzoorbux@gmail.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/export-media-as-zip or install via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Media > Export Media as ZIP.
  4. Click the Download ZIP button to export your images.
sections.faq:
Who can access the ZIP export feature?

Only administrators have access to the export page and feature.

What file types are included?

Only image files (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .webp) are included.

Where is the ZIP file stored?

The ZIP file is generated temporarily and deleted automatically after the download.
